columns.name: QUESTIONNAIRE_ID
columns.description: This is the Questionnaire ID of the questionnaire being identified.

columns.name: QUESTIONNAIRE_VERSION
columns.description: This is the Questionnaire Version associated with the Questionnaire ID.

columns.name: QUESTION_ID
columns.description: This is the Question ID associated with the Questionnaire.

columns.name: QUESTION_VERSION
columns.description: This is the Question Version associated with the Question ID in the Questionnaire.

columns.name: ANSWER_ID
columns.description: This is the Answer ID associated with the Question.

columns.name: ANSWER_TEXT
columns.description: This is the text of the Answer Choice in the specified language.

columns.name: LANGUAGE
columns.description: Indicates the code of the language into which the contents of the translatable columns are translated.

columns.name: SOURCE_LANG
columns.description: Indicates the code of the language in which the contents of the translatable columns were originally created.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
